Apply the inverse shift to the output mesh using `offMesh.transform(voxelsShift)` to restore the original mesh position [S1].

The evidence explicitly states in the code comments and the Python code example that `offMesh.transform(voxelsShift)` is used to shift the output mesh to the initial mesh position. The claim describes applying the inverse shift to restore the original position. In the context of the provided code, `voxelsShift` represents the transformation applied to the voxels relative to the original mesh (often a translation to center or align). Applying this same transformation to the reconstructed mesh (`offMesh`) effectively reverses the spatial offset introduced during the voxelization process, thereby restoring the mesh to its original position relative to the coordinate system. The evidence supports the action and the intent described in the claim.
